outcome: Postpartum depression (EPDS score ≥10) at 1 week and 6 weeks postpartum
cohort: 110 postnatal mothers (55 spontaneous conception, 55 assisted conception) at a tertiary care hospital
finding: Mode of conception was not associated with an increase in postpartum depression among women who underwent infertility treatment.
mod_finding: The mode of conception (spontaneous vs. assisted) was not associated with an increased risk of postpartum depression.
